主要内容: The document outlines a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, detailing the issuance of various senior global medium-term notes. These notes are linked to different indices, including the S&P 500® Index and the iShares® MSCI EAFE Index Fund, with varying maturity dates and principal amounts. The filing includes details about the pricing and settlement dates for each note, such as the Buffered Bullish Booster Notes and Return Optimization Securities. The notes are issued under the Bank’s shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806). The filing is intended to be incorporated by reference into the Bank’s registration statement, providing transparency about the securities being issued. The text describes a financial filing related to securities issued by the Royal Bank of Canada. It outlines the issuance of Reverse Convertible Notes linked to the Common Stock of Silver Wheaton Corporation, with a value of $707,000. The filing includes details about the securities, such as the linked underlying stock and the dates of the issuance. It also includes legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian and New York law. The filing was published on January 31, 2012, and signed by authorized officers of the Royal Bank of Canada.
